summary: Implement a custom health check endpoint at /api/health that aggregates status from Spring Boot Actuator health indicators (Database and Redis) and returns it in a specific JSON format.

plan.title: Add dependencies
plan.description: Add spring-boot-starter-actuator and spring-boot-starter-data-redis to pom.xml to enable health indicators and Redis support.

plan.title: Create HealthResponse DTO
plan.description: Create a DTO class to represent the required JSON response structure, including status, timestamp, and component statuses.

plan.title: Create HealthService
plan.description: Implement HealthService to fetch health status from Actuator's HealthContributorRegistry, specifically checking 'db' and 'redis' indicators.

plan.title: Create HealthController
plan.description: Implement HealthController with a GET mapping for /api/health that returns the HealthResponse DTO populated by HealthService.

plan.title: Enable health indicators in configuration
plan.description: Ensure health indicators are enabled in application.properties if necessary (though usually enabled by default).

plan.title: Create Integration Test
plan.description: Create HealthControllerIT.java to verify the /api/health endpoint returns 200 OK and the correct JSON structure when dependencies are UP.

acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Execute a GET request to /api/health and check status code.

acceptance_criteria.description: Database check returns UP when connected
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Check 'components.database' value in response when DB is available.

acceptance_criteria.description: Redis check returns UP when connected
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Check 'components.redis' value in response when Redis is available.

acceptance_criteria.description: Status is 'DOWN' if any component is unavailable
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Simulate a component failure and verify 'status' field in response.

risks: Redis connection might fail if Docker service is not running during tests (though Spring Boot Docker Compose should handle it if enabled).
Package structure might need adjustment based on project conventions.
